lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Hey. Nice!\nI was hoping we’d run into each other!

You know there’s a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pokémon Gym[VAR COLOR(0000)] up this way,
right, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]?\c
You can battle against the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Gym Leader[VAR COLOR(0000)] there,
and he’s seriously strong!
If you want to get stronger, you’ve definitely\ngotta try to take him on!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Hah! Jeez, [VAR PKNICK(0003)]!
You’re ready for a good battle, too, huh?
Who wouldn’t be!\c
All right, then. You’re making me want to cheer
you guys on, too, so take these!

I bought some for you with the prize money
I’ve been earning in all my battles.\c
Beat that Gym Leader, [VAR TRNAME(0000)],
and you can really call yourself a true Trainer!\c
Give it your best!
